fusions.name: Rooted by a Glare
fusions.desc: Fixes the first enemy in line with a glare for 11 damage and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Fixing Stare
fusions.desc: Stares down a narrow cone 4 tiles long, dealing 3 damage to everything in it with a 40% chance to leave each [Marked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Slit Pupils
fusions.desc: Increases your critical chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Eyeshine
fusions.desc: At night, your damage rises by 12%.
